name: cabc-website-runtime
description: Dathorn runtime only; application bundles are built off-server.

scripts.runtime:check: node -e "const D=require('better-sqlite3'); const d=new D(':memory:'); d.exec('CREATE TABLE t (n INTEGER); INSERT INTO t VALUES (1)'); if(d.prepare('SELECT n FROM t').get().n!==1) process.exit(1); d.close(); console.log('SQLite runtime OK')"
